description: Create or delete export groups on a Vexata VX100 array.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: Vexata VX100 array hostname or IPv4 Address.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Vexata API user password. Uses the VEXATA_PASSWORD environment variable as a fallback.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Creates export group when present or delete when absent. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Vexata API user with administrative privileges. Uses the VEXATA_USER environment variable as a fallback.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to false when certificates are not trusted. If set to true, please make sure Python >= 2.7.9 is installed on the given machine. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Create export group named db_export.
  community.general.vexata_eg:
    name: db_export
    vg: dbvols
    ig: dbhosts
    pg: pg1
    state: present
    array: vx100_ultra.test.com
    user: admin
    password: secret

- name: Delete export group named db_export
  community.general.vexata_eg:
    name: db_export
    state: absent
    array: vx100_ultra.test.com
    user: admin
    password: secret
